title: Acquisition-local held-condition calcium response prediction
disposition_reason: Executable complete-condition preparation, scoring and an exploratory typed viewer are now present as source. They preserve six acquisition-local condition-mean holdouts in both orders. Authentic runtime, provider feasibility, context isolation and model performance remain unqualified; unknown mouse/session mapping and physical timing still preclude animal-transfer and evoked-response claims.

scientific_target.question: For each of six acquisitions and both ABC/CBA query orders, can the eleven permitted condition means across the six acquisitions predict the withheld acquisition/order trajectory on its complete native frame grid?
scientific_target.known_answer: For every original ROI and native frame of the withheld acquisition/order, the finite-sample mean across all50 released trials, with finite-observation counts retained separately. Zero means with zero counts are missing-data placeholders, not observed zeros; withheld means and counts remain private.
scientific_target.answer_origin: All twelve panelDE_expt{1..6}_F_{abc,cba} tensors in the pinned Figure2 source NPZ; recovered preparation averages finite trials at each ROI/frame and retains every original row. This is condition-mean prediction, not single-trial visual/opto-combination or animal-transfer evaluation.
scientific_target.case_unit: One held condition for one acquisition, with ROI rows and native frames nested inside;12 contexts represent six acquisitions×two order conditions.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Acquisition for descriptive finite results; independent animal/session mapping is unresolved, so six acquisitions cannot be asserted to be six mice.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Retrospective within-acquisition condition generalization only. Full native-frame means may include baseline/artifact structure; physical stimulus onset and animal transfer are outside the delivered claim.
exclusions: No cross-animal generalization or independent-animal uncertainty.
No millisecond response-window or original-paper reproduction claim from native frame indices.

Sanitized acquisition/order/ROI identifiers, complete native frame indices and the training-only normalization scale. Physical timestamps, onset windows, optical-dose features and animal/session identities have not been established by this delivered input contract.

observation_contract.split: Hold out one complete acquisition/order condition per context. observation_contract.coverage: Complete selected acquisition-local condition means: six acquisitions, both orders, every original ROI and native frame. The broader single-trial visual/opto-combination and animal-transfer objective remains unimplemented; two orders do not create separate cohorts.

primary.name: acquisition_macro_normalized_response_rmse
primary.aggregation: For each query cell, compute MSE over target frames with positive finite-observation counts. Divide by the squared training-only scale: square root of the equal-cell mean of within-cell population temporal variances over observed frames of that acquisition’s visible opposite order. Average normalized cell MSE equally over observed target cells, then take the square root for that context. Average all12 context RMSEs equally; equivalently, average the two order RMSEs within each acquisition and then average six acquisitions. Do not pool cells/frames or take a square root after averaging order MSEs.
primary.rationale: Recovered complete-support condition-mean prediction metric; original mean reduction, missingness policy and opposite-order normalizer are executable source. Dense trajectory reconstruction alone does not establish neural understanding. Source availability does not establish authentic evaluator or reference competence.

secondary: Unnormalized native-unit RMSE and all per-acquisition/order errors.
Additive/order-agnostic versus sequence-aware matched model errors on identical support.
Post-onset versus baseline/artifact sensitivity only after physical timing is verified, not by relabeling arbitrary frame indices.

No score is inferred from an unscored producer or retained viewer capture.
